metadata.title: Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave — Character and Part I Recruitment Data
metadata.description: Machine-readable source data for comparing recruitable characters across the four Part I routes. No subjective rankings or class growth modifiers included.
metadata.growth_interpretation: Personal stat increase chance per level up; class and mount modifiers excluded. Mu effective values reflect an innate personal ability and are separately listed.
metadata.recruitment_interpretation: min_renown/min_support are minimal thresholds; earliest_chapter is the earliest reported chapter for that route. Additional named items, gold, requests, deadlines and paralogues are in requirements.
metadata.null_meaning: Unknown or not independently confirmed, not zero, not an empty requirement, and not necessarily inapplicable.
metadata.scope: 63 playable units shown in roster guide, including story/prologue/post-Part-I characters, with Part I recruitment requirements when documented.
limitations: Starting level, starting class and base stat vectors are unpopulated because a comprehensive consistently sourced table was not verified.
Proficiencies are verified for the 50 characters in the Part I recruitment roster; the other 13 use null, not empty arrays.
Several secondary sources disagree about growths or route requirements: check data_conflicts.
Earliest chapters and recruitment windows may vary with route events; not every missability deadline has been verified.
Personal ability effects are concise English paraphrases, not official game text; some unique story abilities have unknown unlock levels.
